description: 教育部臺灣學術網路資安事件個案分析 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 教育部資訊及科技教育司. 臺灣學術網路上資安事件之個別事件，進行鑑識分析後，所產生的事件分析報告。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 教育部資訊及科技教育司. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-07-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
